author: FXTD Studios Research, 7 Nov 2026
purpose: The Crew holdout, run once, on the arm the 7 Nov rule chose: w4 + lock_dqs050g (largest smallest margin 6.7 %; dqs060g 3.8 %, b040 0.7 %; lockguard_20261107 decision table).

candidates.primary: w4 (research_bin_hinge_w4_20261102 step1600) + lock_dqs050g; the checkpoint's SHA-256 is recorded in the evaluation output

decision_rule: Registered 7 Nov 2026 before the holdout set is built or any model is run on it. The arm passes the holdout if, over its kept cases: 0 EV RMS in codes <= the analytic inverse's 0 EV RMS on the same cases + 0.1 code (the rule the lock arms were chosen under, relative to this set's own analytic); mean -3 EV, +3 EV and H no worse than analytic; no new negative luminance; no remaining display error over 1 code. tools/holdout_verdict.py applies it. Run once: no rerun, no other arm, no change of rule after the result. Reported with it: the evaluator's strict gates, the bootstrap over scenes, and the result whatever it is.
if_it_passes: RUDRA ACES 2 = w4 + lock_dqs050g may leave preview, after the separate steps: the lock in the native engine with parity to the Python oracle, export with backend parity, provenance naming this checkpoint and this holdout, visual review.
if_it_fails: RUDRA ACES 2 stays preview. The next lever is the one the 2 Nov note lists: real-footage training data; and a holdout across projects and cameras.
honesty: Nothing of the holdout has been read: the fresh and development sets are development evidence.
limits: One project, one camera (see the grade set registration). Single frames. release_authorized stays false in every output.
